'''Irackant''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] who worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] around the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], hunting down [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] war criminals. Irackant flew the [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat]] ''[[Krakana's Claw]]'' and carried out extensive modifications to the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], inlcuding an alteration to the ship's environmental systems, to give the ''Krakana's Claw'' a more moist atmosphere.
